text: Private initiatives are emerging to fill the ICO disclosure and rating gap, including a joint venture between Ambisafe and the rating agency ICOrating created to ensure high quality standards and support investor due diligence.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615

abstract: To combat these shortcomings, a private initiative, a joint-venture between Ambisafe Inc.59 and the Russian-based rating agency ICOrating,60 has been created to ensure high-quality standards, supporting investors in their due-diligence
